child.label: Wellbeing & Getting Help
child.description: Questions about how many people would agree with a rule of thumb about looking after health and wellbeing, getting medical or mental-health help, and staying in safe relationships, rated from "practically no one" to "practically everyone".
child.not_for: Rules about avoiding danger, accidents, emergencies, and feeling scared (use Safety & Fear).
examples: How many people would agree: "You should see a doctor when you are sick"?
How many people would agree: "It is okay to ask for help when you need it"?

child.label: Safety & Fear
child.description: Questions about how many people would agree with a rule of thumb about avoiding danger and accidents, handling emergencies, and feeling or causing fear, rated from "practically no one" to "practically everyone".
child.not_for: Rules about health, self-care, and seeking medical or emotional help (use Wellbeing & Getting Help).
examples: How many people would agree: "You should be careful when driving in snow"?
How many people would agree: "It is understandable to feel scared"?
